pretreatments.description: Phosphoric acid pretreatment: Concentrated phosphoric acid (83–85.9 %) was used at 50 °C for 50 min, followed by washing with distilled water and centrifugation, with acetone used for extraction and precipitation of hemicellulose, and acid washed to pH 7.0 before drying.
Organosolv pretreatment: Substrates were treated with ethanol (75 % v/v) at 150 °C for 30 min in the presence of sulfuric acid (1 % w/w), then neutralized and dried at 40 °C.
Dilute acid pretreatment: Substrates were treated with 0.5 % w/w sulfuric acid at 140 °C for 5 min, followed by washing with distilled water, neutralization, and drying at 40 °C.
